This tool creates a plan on your device. It does not contact customers, publish anything or start a paid membership.

Your action plan

Choose one goal to build a plan.

Four practical steps

  1. Check your organization name, location, website and category.
  2. Explain who each program serves, service area, eligibility, accessibility, current capacity and the responsible contact.
  3. Publish volunteer, participation or resource needs only when your organization can confirm they are current.
  4. Track discovery and participation separately from donations, beneficiaries and community outcomes.

Keep these rules in mind

  • Do not imply endorsement by a charity, government, faith group or Franklin Navigator.
  • Urgent services and public benefits cannot be sold as paid ranking.
  • Protect beneficiary, child, health, legal and other sensitive information.
